latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator for Marketing — Initial Release

- Instantly generate branded marketing videos by uploading images or text and describing your needs.
- Automatic cloud backend setup — handles token management and session creation seamlessly.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG formats (up to 500MB).
- 1080p MP4 downloads ready for immediate use on ad platforms.
- Includes simple prompt-based workflows, file uploads, credits check, and real-time status updates.
- Built-in error handling for authentication, file limits, and export restrictions.
